stories.title: MPSC Officer Allegedly Printed 300 Drug Inspector Exam Questions, Handed Copies To Superior In Parking Lot
stories.summary: According to the chargesheet, Nakate allegedly involved Under Secretary Abhijit Lendve in the conspiracy to ensure that he would have the protection of a senior official if the irregularity came to light. stories.title: Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prominent Delhi hospitals in six years; one death every three days
stories.summary: Around 83 cases of lung cancer were recorded every month across prominent government hospitals in the national capital in the last six and a half year period, with one patient succumbing to the disease every three days. This information was provided in response to an RTI query to AIIMS, RML Hospital, Safdarjung Hospital and the Delhi State Cancer Institute.

stories.title: India-Nepal joint military exercise begins in Rupandehi
stories.summary: A joint military training exercise between Nepal and India, focusing on disaster management, forest welfare and humanitarian assistance, commenced on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). The 20th edition of the training exercise, “Abhyas Suryakiran”, began at Nepal Army Battle School in Saljhandi, Rupandehi district, according to a press release issued by the Nepal Army.

stories.title: Asian women 'never heard' on health, says director
stories.summary: A community centre director in Luton said a "hidden generation" of Asian women had "voices that were never heard" when it came to their wellbeing. The Let Women Speak report , external commissioned by the borough council in Luton, where the onset of poor female health happens five years earlier than average, also found over 70% of women aged 45-64 had an at-risk body mass index.

stories.title: Is your cough hiding a real problem? Doctor reveals everything about early detection of pneumonia this winter
stories.summary: India accounts for nearly a quarter of the world’s community-acquired pneumonia cases, an estimated four million a year, and roughly one in five of those patients require hospital admission. Among children under five, pneumonia and related respiratory infections continue to claim well over a lakh of lives annually.

stories.title: ICMR-NIV develops multiplex RT-PCR test to detect dengue, chikungunya, Zika simultaneously
stories.summary: Scientists at the Indian Council of Medical Research’s National Institute of Virology (ICMR-NIV), Pune, have developed and validated a laboratory test that can detect dengue, chikungunya and Zika viruses simultaneously from a single sample. The test could help doctors and laboratories distinguish between the three mosquito-borne infections, which often present similar symptoms in their early stages.

stories.title: Antibiotics for children: What parents should know about leftovers and missed doses
stories.summary: Prolonged or excessive use may raise the risk of more serious complications. Consult a doctor before giving a child antibiotics. Antibiotic overuse is a real concern. When someone in the family, even a child, complains of an ache or notices some swelling, it can be tempting to reach for antibiotics.

stories.title: Food licence of NSCI, 2 other eateries suspended
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the food licence of three prominent Mumbai establishments—the National Sports Club of India (NSCI) in Worli, British Brewing Company in Lower Parel and Crusto’s Pizza in Prabhadevi—following inspections that revealed food safety and hygiene violations. At NSCI, a prominent sports and recreational club in Worli, inspectors found flies in the kitchen and cockroaches near the wash basin.

stories.title: IIT Madras expands campus health services with new autism, sleep research facilities

stories.title: Govt weights curbs on excessive drug markups beyond cancer medicines
stories.summary: The Centre is examining whether trade margin caps should be extended beyond cancer medicines to other high-cost and essential drugs, including antibiotics, diabetes and heart medicines, as well as biologics, while seeking to avoid disruptions to drug availability and hospital supplies, two government officials said.

stories.title: Punjab sends 4-doctor panel for director, health services post
stories.summary: With the term of the present director of health services (DHS), Suman Singh, ending on Tuesday, Punjab has sent a panel of four doctors for the post. Suman Singh, who has been serving for the past five years, received a one-year extension last year after reaching retirement age.

stories.title: From slurred speech to an uneven smile: Doctor shares mini-stroke warning signs and when to call an ambulance
stories.summary: Slurred speech that clears up in minutes may still signal a mini-stroke. When someone briefly slurs their words and then starts speaking normally again, it is easy to chalk it up to tiredness , especially if they say they feel fine. But such a sudden change in speech can be a sign of stroke.

stories.title: ​Breast cancer: Can AI help spot it sooner? Inside the NHS’s massive new trial of 700,000 women​
stories.summary: Artificial intelligence has already made its way into healthcare, showing up everywhere from hospital billing systems to the screens of radiologists. But now, the UK’s National Health Service is setting out to answer a much bigger question: can AI genuinely help doctors find breast cancer earlier, and can it do that better or faster than current methods?

stories.title: Ben Stokes enters IPL auction at maximum base price; 11 Bangladesh players in pool
stories.summary: Former England captain Ben Stokes and Australian batter Cameron Bancroft are among the overseas players who have registered for the IPL auction, news agency PTI reported. stories.title: World chess championship: Gritty Gukesh weathers time pressure, holds Sindarov
stories.summary: There was this man-against-machine match in chess in 1998. If you thought the machine might have won, you are wrong. The man, named Viswanathan Anand, beat Fritz. stories.title: ‘ICC, boards need to step in’: Harbhajan on India-Pakistan cricket skirmishes
stories.summary: The last couple of India-Pakistan cricket contests, while they've provided plenty of excitement, have also seen ugly scenes of skirmishes between the players. stories.title: Asia Cup heroes Aaryavir Sehwag and Mohit Ulva in IPL auction register; Ben Stokes, Sonny Baker in too
stories.summary: Aaryavir Sehwag, son of legendary Indian opener Virender Sehwag , has registered for the upcoming IPL 2027 auction. stories.title: Champions League: Bellingham wondergoal helps Real Madrid thump PSV; Arsenal and Man City held

stories.title: Three Fort Hood shooting survivors lose final appeal to witness Nidal Hasan’s execution
stories.summary: Three survivors of the shooting at Fort Hood will not be allowed to witness the execution of Nidal Hasan, who fatally shot 13 people in the attack at the Texas Army post in 2009, military officials said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). stories.summary: Sooryavanshi has taken the cricketing world by storm with his astonishing exploits, most recently smashing a breathtaking 204 off just 53 balls in a List A match on Tuesday. stories.title: Russia accuses NATO member Estonia of hostile actions ‘on the verge of unleashing open war’
